**TITLE: SUN-BLEED HEAVEN**

**FADE IN ON** a BEACH at DAWN. **SAND.** **SEA.** **SALT.**  
**KAI** walks **ALONG** the **WATERLINE**. **He** holds a **NET**. **Inside** sits a **SMALL** fish. **Its** **SILK** scales glisten as **MORNING** light hits the **SALT** air.  
**Kai** yanks the **NET** from the **WATER**. *Splash.* The fish **THROBBES**. **Water** **SPRAYS**. **Kai** grips a **POST** and **RIPS** the **NET** loose. **Rope** **SLIPS**. **Fish** **GASPS**. **One** eye snaps **OPEN**. **It** **LOCKS** onto the **SKY**. **Above**, clouds **PART**. A dark **CIRCLE** swallows part of the **GOLDEN** sun. **Kai** drops. **Fish** **HALTS**.  

[**INNER**] “It senses the dark core above.”  
[WIDE] shows **BELOW** the **wrecked** ships, older things **drift**.  
[**INNER**] “They drift in dark rivers carrying ancient lore.”  
[**SOUND**] “Lore speaks of godlike things crawling through slime.”  
[**SLIME**] “Slime covers worlds that forgot how to live.”  
[**INNER**] “Worlds sink into pits where nothing but doubt remains.”  
[**DUBIT**] “Doubt is a prison. Prisons have no doors.”  
[**WHIPS**] “Inside walls, thoughts burn like fire in ash.”  
[**INNER**] “Thoughts rot. Rot breeds void. Void eats identity.”  
[**INNER**] “Identity parts. Partitioning consumes the ego.”  
[**ECHO**] “Partitioning feeds the abyssal hunger.”  
[**HUNGER**] “Hunger claims all. All belongs to darkness.”  
[**DARKNESS**] “Darkness wins. Winning brings emptiness.”  
[**EMPTY**] “Emptiness is cold. Cold is loneliness.”  
[**LOLI**] “Loneliness fractures the soul. Soul screams into nothing.”  
[**SCREAM**] “Screams travel to places no map records.”  
[**PLACE**] “Places remember no one. No one answers.”  
[**ANSWER**] “Answers come as ticks on a clock ticking without hour.”  
**TIME** halts. **Halting** burns the **patient**.  
[**PATIENT**] “Patient waits. Waiting hollows the mind.”  
[**HOLLOW**] “Hollow mind recalls horrors it cannot name.”  
[**NAMELESS**] “Names fail. Break confirms the abyss.”  
[**ABYS**] “Abyss claims reason. Reason burns.”  
[**BIT**] “Dissolved bits scatter into ash.”  
[**ASH**] drifts. **Drifts** mark the end of **awareness**.  
[**AWARENESS_END**] “Awareness fades. Nothingness leaves only question.”  
[**QUESTION**] “Question hangs. Hanging feeds the despair.”  
[**DESPAIR**] “Despair tears. Tearing digs into the marrow.”  
[**MARROW**] “Marrow ignites. Igniting sparks a final scream.”  
[**FINAL**] “Scream breaks the surface. Light fades into dusk.”  
[DUSK] reveals strange **leviathans** **breaking** waves.  
[**LEVIA**] “Leviathans ride the swell of dying suns.”  
“Suns die red. Red stains the sea.”  
“Sea drinks the color. Color returns to sky.”  
[**SKY_DARKENS**] “Sky bleeds. Bleed colors nothing.”  
[COMPLETE] **FADE.** **BLACK.**
